Resolves #19878

**What kind of change does this PR introduce?**

- [x] Bugfix

**Does this PR introduce a breaking change?**

- [ ] Yes
- [x] No

**The PR fulfills this requirement:**

- [x] It's submitted to the `dev` branch, _not_ the `main` branch

**Other information:**

`createPooledItem()` built the option's `aria-label` as `<label>, <count> matches`, so a value with exactly one matching row was announced as "sloemo01, 1 matches". The label now uses `match` when the count is 1 and `matches` for every other count; the visible row still shows only the number.

- `src/list/ValuePicker.mjs`: pluralize next to the count the method already reads.
- `test/playwright/unit/list/ValuePicker.spec.mjs`: one new case covering counts 0, 1 and 2 on the mounted rows (AC-1, AC-2).
- `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderMenuStateNL.spec.mjs`: the twelve `1 matches` expectations become `1 match` (AC-3).

**Verification**

```
$ npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/list/ValuePicker.spec.mjs
13 passed (2.3s)

$ npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/list
66 passed (4.8s)

$ grep -rn "1 matches" test/
(no output)
```

Against the previous source the new case fails (`Expected: "Value 1, 1 match"` / `Received: "Value 1, 1 matches"`). The e2e tier was not run locally — it needs Chrome and the dev server, and your CI runs it on every PR.

**AI disclosure:** drafted with an AI coding assistant (OpenCode Go, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`). The failing-first run, the green run and the expectation updates above come from this branch; no human line-by-line review of the diff happened before submitting.
